LOVE MOVES.

LOVE IT FORWARD

It always has. We just built somewhere for it to go.

THIS BEHAVIOUR IS AS OLD AS PEOPLE.

Someone experiences something. And immediately, before they even finish experiencing it, they think of someone else.

You would love this. This one’s for you. You have to feel this.

That thought is the most powerful moment in commerce. It’s also the one nobody built infrastructure for. Until now.

LOVE IT FORWARD IS AN INTRODUCTION.

Not a referral. Not a reward. Not a campaign mechanic. An introduction.

Someone who loves what you do chooses someone they love, writes them something real and puts something behind it.

The receiver opens it and finds a person, not a brand. A note from someone who knows them. That changes everything before they even arrive.

THIS IS THE MOMENT.

Someone in your life thought of you. Specifically. By name. They wrote you something in their own words, and they put something real toward an experience they wanted you to have.

You have a message from someone who loves you. At first, you only know someone chose you. Then comes the reveal.

It was Amy.

And you read why.

Not a brand message. Not copy written for everyone. Something written for you.

You haven’t arrived yet. You already belong.

THE TRUST WAS ALREADY THERE.

Love It Forward doesn’t manufacture the relationship. That already exists. You already trust the person who sent it. You already believe what they’re telling you.

Being thought of feels good. Doing something for someone feels good. Love It Forward just gives those feelings somewhere to go.

AND THEN

Someone else comes to mind. You know exactly who. So you choose them, you write them something real and you put something behind it.

A new Love It Forward begins. New person. New reason. New act.

THE RECEIVER BECOMES THE GIVER.

Not because anyone asked. Not because there’s something in it for them. Because being genuinely thought of makes you want someone else to feel it too.

Love moves.

AND YOU GET TO KNOW IT MATTERED.

You can see: Jody chose something. Jody sent love back. And if Jody chooses someone else: Jody Loved It Forward.

You don’t see who she chose. You don’t see what she wrote. That belongs to them. But you know what you started is still moving.

And when it stops, it stops. No pressure. No obligation. Just the pleasure of knowing something thoughtful you did travelled further than you.

NO INCENTIVE.NO POINTS.NO REFERRAL CODE.

Just a person thinking of another person, with a way to do something about it.

People keep the meaning. The brand sees the movement.

CULTURE TRAVELS THROUGH PEOPLE.

So does love.

Real community doesn’t come from campaigns. It comes from people bringing people in.

Love It Forward is what that looks like when it has somewhere to go.

HOME FOR BRANDS ABOUT

YOU HAVE AN ACQUISITION CHANNEL YOU’VE NEVER BEEN ABLE TO SEE.

Your happiest customers are out there right now introducing people they love to you.

No campaign started it. No ad triggered it. No email nudged it. Someone just loved what you do and thought of someone. You never knew it happened.

Love It Forward makes it visible. And gives it somewhere to go.

EVERY DAY, YOUR CUSTOMERS ARE DOING YOUR BEST MARKETING.

Without being asked. Without a reward. They’re texting a friend, mentioning you at dinner, saying you have to go there to someone who trusts them completely.

That friend shows up and buys something. You see the order, but you don’t see the introduction that started it.

In your system, it looks like new revenue. You lost the reason it happened.

That’s your most powerful growth moment and it’s completely invisible to you.

LOVE IT FORWARD IS A NEW CHANNEL.

Not a referral program. Not a gift card. Not loyalty mechanics. Infrastructure for the moment one person introduces another person to something they love.

Your customer chooses someone, writes them something real and funds the introduction personally. The receiver finds out who chose them and why before they see anything else.

The relationship arrives first. The brand gets a new customer who was already warmed before they walked in.

AI CAN SCALE A RECOMMENDATION.

It can’t replace who you trust.

The more automated the world becomes, the more a human voice matters. A friend. A sister. Someone who knows you well enough.

When a brand comes through someone you trust, the trust gets there first.

That’s not something you can manufacture. But it’s something you can give somewhere to go.

AND THEN SOMETHING HAPPENS.

The receiver wants to do it for someone, not because you asked and not because there’s anything in it for them, but because being genuinely thought of makes you want to think of someone.

The receiver becomes the giver. One introduction can become another.

Your customer didn’t just bring you a customer. They started something.

FOR THE FIRST TIME, YOU CAN SEE WHAT THE INTRODUCTION CREATES.

Who introduced whom, what happened next, whether they came back and whether they Loved It Forward.

The movement that was always happening underneath your best growth is measurable, attributable, yours to build on.

Not a transaction. An introduction. With a full story behind it.

THIS ISN’T A GIFT CARD.

A gift card tracks value to redemption. Love It Forward tracks the introduction beyond it.

The person. The reason. The reveal. The gratitude. What continued after.

Every time someone Loves It Forward, a new introduction begins, a new person is chosen and a new relationship is funded.

The introductions keep moving. You can see what they create.

YOUR COMMERCE STAYS YOURS.

Checkout. Payments. Inventory. Fulfilment. Returns. All of it stays where it is.

Love It Forward carries the person, the reason, the funded value, the reveal, the gratitude, and the attribution.

Private details stay private, and it sits on top of what you already have.

For pilot brands, setup is on us.

TRANSACTIONS HAVE INFRASTRUCTURE.

Introductions didn’t. Until now.

People keep the meaning. The brand sees the growth.

Have love. Will share.

HOME FOR BRANDS ABOUT

I SAW RECEIVING TURN INTO GIVING.

Before Love It Forward was a company, I watched it happen in real life. That stayed with me.

Amy Krofchick

Founder & CEO, Love It Forward

I’M AMY KROFCHICK.

I founded The NOW, a wellness company that grew to more than 100 locations across the U.S. I know what it takes to build something people genuinely love.

But somewhere along the way, I became more interested in a different question. Not: what do people get from a brand? But: what do people do for each other because of one?

BEFORE LOVE IT FORWARD,
THERE WAS LIFEHOOD.

Los Angeles. 2020.

I opened a retail and service space around one simple idea:
make it easy to do something good for someone else.

People arrived knowing only that someone had chosen to give them a treatment.
They didn’t know who, then they found out, and they read why.

What mattered wasn’t only the treatment.
It was being chosen. Being thought of. Being seen.
And then something happened.

I WATCHED RECEIVING TURN INTO GIVING.

Right there, in real time. In the moment of being genuinely thought of, someone else came to mind.

Nearly 70% chose to send a treatment to someone else. No incentive. No discount. No referral reward. They just wanted someone they loved to feel what they felt.

I didn’t manufacture that. I just gave it somewhere to go. That was the behaviour I was looking for.

THEN I SAW WHAT THE BEHAVIOUR COULD CREATE.

One person chose another, and that person chose someone else. One customer became two, then three, then more. My customers were bringing me my next customers.

The feeling created the behaviour. The behaviour created the growth. That was the unlock.

LOVE IT FORWARD IS MY LOVE NOTE TO THAT.

To the people who know us, to the things worth sharing, to being thought of and to thinking of someone else. To the businesses people love enough to bring someone they care about into.

That’s how community actually grows. Someone makes you feel seen. You want someone else to feel that too.

HAVE LOVE. WILL SHARE.

Have love. Will share.
